text.p: Amserv Group, Estonia's car concern, will issue 100,000 shares in a public offering between May 27-June 10, Hoiupank Investments said on Tuesday.
The price of the shares, which have a face value of 10 kroons, is 97 kroons, Mart Magi, director of Hoiupank Investments, told Reuters.
Amserv Group will use the issue to finance domestic projects and its operations in Latvia and Lithuania, Magi said.
Magi added that a principled decision has been made to list the company's shares on the Tallinn Stock Exchange.
The group represents Toyota, Opel and Eurocar.
It had a consolidated net turnover of 206 million kroons last year, which is estimated to grow to 260 million kroons this year.
Its net profit was 2.9 million kroons in 1996, and is expected to grow to 5.5 million kroons this year.
Its share capital is 2.89 million kroons, of which 19 percent is held by Japan's Sumitomo corporation. The rest is divided between three individuals.
